payload.name: Cell Process
payload.description: Cell Processes are Pre-Steps and must be followed by a Production process step - these pre-steps are treated simlar to phantoms - any BOM components are consumed by the product step immediately following the last Cell step. Any number of Cell steps may proceed a production step. Inventory can not be created for Cell steps.

payload.name: Optional
payload.description: Optional processes are added to strategies in order to provide a distinct list of processes that a scheduler can add to a work order ad-hoc. processes not identified as optional may not be added to work order for specific products.

payload.name: Disassembly
payload.description: Disassembly steps are 'reverse bom' meaning the coproducts identified here - are generaly components that 'went into' the original assembly, during the disassembly step you are deconstructing back into the subset of components you defined.

payload.name: Outside Process
payload.description: Outside Processes are handled externally to your organization. There is an outbound shipment and a receipt involved (multiple steps) for this 1 operation.

payload.name: Production
payload.description: Standard inhouse production process step. If the first step in an Assembly, you must defined a BOM.

payload.name: Inventory
payload.description: Inventory Process types - are used for products that do not have manufacturing steps - Components/Raw Materials that are purchased (or otherwise received), ByProductcs, CoProduct (Inventory). Only 1 Inventory Process type can exist within a strategy.

payload.name: Rework
payload.description: Rework processes may only be added to Rework Strategies. These are unique to a non-standard manufacturing flow. The first process must have a BOM (so the system knows what to rework) however, this component may sometimes be added to a work order. If the strategy does not have a BOM on the first process, any work orders generated will be done so in a HOLD status until you define the BOM.
